rtl_param: CGR = 8 (rtl/v41rom/ot_v41_rom_elem_qx_pq_w10.sv, threaded through ot_v41_rom_elem_q_qxpq_w10); default 0 = single gate u_e.g_cg.u_cg
why: S81-CORE-LAT root cause: one gate u_e.g_cg.u_cg drove 34.3k flops + 4 ROMs (~70 % of sinks) -> stacked trees, 456-552 ps TT vs 250. COORD 06:38: one gate copy per in-core region on the same registered enable (kept copies u_ze_r<k> of u_z: d = qz_zd, arst rst_n_pin, RV 1), in-core H-tree from the centre entry.
index: k = 2*col + row; col 0..3 W->E, row 0 = S, 1 = N; each of the 4 in-core leaf islands (one per column, COORD/S81-CORE-LAT-R2 DIE_TREE_IN 4x1) feeds the 2 gates of its column

leaf_islands_plan_msg_um.note: values from the S81-CORE-LAT-R2 brief; 63.72/446.04/110.16 are not multiples of 4.32 from the core origin (snapped from 0: 64.80/444.96/112.32) -- master plan to confirm the lattice phase

sink_method: Yosys 0.68 elaboration of the die parameters + CGR 8 (read_verilog -sv -DSYNTHESIS, proc, flatten, opt, opt_dff), flop bits per gated clock net; pre-synthesis estimate (kit synthesis may merge / remove a few %). Ungated clk flops: 12,258 (walker / tags / reset / enable copies) on the core clock directly.
notes: ROM clk pins sit at the core centre y (105.56 S / 115.79 N) on the ROM inner edge x 151.22 (g_mac[0]) / 359.42 (g_mac[1]), i.e. 22-26 um inside the inner column rectangles: the outer-column gates (r0/r1/r6/r7) keep ROM + its capture registers on ONE gate (ROM -> capture is the 600-of-833 ps single-cycle path); reach from leaf island col 0/3 to the ROM pin ~87-95 um < leaf reach 174.6.

Column loads are unequal (outer ~5.8k + 2 ROMs, inner ~12.4-13.0k): the leaf trees differ by about one buffer stage; per-island sizing must be plan-computed (METHODOLOGY 12.8 d1) or the partition re-balanced by moving the lane input registers (g_pl, ~1.1k per mac) -- not done here.

ROM -> site mapping from gen_core_kit_legacy MACRO_TCL (instance-name order): g_mac[0].u_rom0 (25.92,43.392 R180), u_rom1 (25.92,115.008 MY), g_mac[1].u_rom0 (359.424,43.392 MX), u_rom1 (359.424,115.008 R0).

regions.drives: g_mac[0] outer S: u_rom0 + cap0 + u_x x slices + issue control copies (g_mi, mz_bk/fp4/c0/c1) + bk_h + lane input registers g_l3.g_pl (gclk_ma)
g_mac[0] outer N: u_rom1 + cap1 (gclk_c1) + chains u_c0/u_c1, pair adder u_pair, u_pp/u_pt delays, segment-tree adder/tag pipe (pclk), output registers (gclk_mb)
g_mac[1] inner S: lane u_l0 + the x boundary registers g_qb.g_bx (gclk_bx = gclk = gclk_r[4])
g_mac[1] outer S: u_rom0 + cap0 + u_x + issue control copies + lane input registers (gclk_ma)
